name: Savdhaan India
description: From a dangerous murder plot to a planned robbery, unmask the gory face of terror through a dramatised version of the crimes happening around you!

videos.title: Sumaila is molested and humiliated
videos.overview: Bapla and his friends attempt to molest Sumaila. Sumaila's father blames her for the occurrence and grounds her. Bapla exposes Sumaila's relation with a guy from another cast. Sumaila is made to walk bare around the villages as a punishment. Her father commits suicide to avoid humiliation.
